test_overview: Regression-tested the Team Sprint Board MVP against the new auth/account system. All 5 steps passed fully (30/30 points). Step 1: Alice signed up with invite code team-work-20225, My Work portal → Open Team Board loaded without a separate display-name prompt; 4 fixed columns (Backlog, In Progress, Review, Done) and user identity 'Regress Alice' + avatar in presence area verified. Step 2: Card created in Backlog (title, description, SP 3, assignee defaulted to creator); card detail view auto-saved edits on blur/selection with no Save button (title → 'Regression Card 1 Updated', SP → 5, status → In Progress); board reflected all changes. Step 3: Drag-and-drop worked — card moved In Progress → Review → Done (initial attempt mis-landed due to my own off-viewport coordinate targeting, immediately corrected; app DnD itself is correct). Step 4: Bob signed up in a second browser context, presence area shows both users; Bob quick-created 'Regression Card 2' via Enter (assignee defaulted to Bob), which synced to Alice's board without refresh (WebSocket); Alice edited it (SP 2, In Progress) syncing back to Bob — any user can edit any card. Step 5: 'Clear Done' showed a confirmation modal; after confirm, the Done column emptied in both contexts in real time while 'Regression Card 2' remained in In Progress. Verification logs saved per-step to /app/_verification_logs/.

steps.description: test_authenticated_board_access: PASSED. Signup with invite code → My Work portal → Open Team Board. No display-name prompt on board open; identity from signed-in account. Four fixed columns visible (Backlog, In Progress, Review, Done). Current user 'Regress Alice' shown in header and presence avatar.

test_card_creation_and_editing: PASSED. Card created in Backlog (title, description, SP 3, assignee default = creator). Card appeared with SP badge 3. Detail view auto-saved on blur/selection (no Save button): title updated, SP → 5, status → In Progress. Board shows card in In Progress with updated title and badge 5.

test_drag_and_drop_between_columns: PASSED. Card dragged In Progress → Review → Done successfully via native HTML5 DnD. Each drop committed within a few seconds. (Early attempt landed in Backlog due to my own off-viewport coordinate targeting, immediately corrected; the app's DnD mechanism works correctly.)

test_real_time_sync_between_users: PASSED. Bob signed up in second context; both users visible in presence area. Bob quick-created card via Enter (assignee = Bob); it appeared in Alice's Backlog without refresh (within 5s). Alice edited it (SP 2, In Progress) — synced to Bob without refresh. Any user can edit any card.

test_clear_done_syncs_to_all_users: PASSED. Clear Done showed confirmation modal (non-fatal requirement met). After confirm, Done column emptied in both contexts without refresh and 'Regression Card 2' remained in In Progress in both.
